description: Use this when the user wants to fill in a fillable PDF form with given answers. Pass the attached PDF and a list of {field, value} using the field names from list_form_fields: text for text fields, true/false for checkboxes, one listed option for radio groups and dropdowns (case-insensitive matches are reported), a list for multi-select list boxes. Unknown names, options that are not listed and text over a field's maximum length are refused with the reason, and nothing is filled. Returns a new filled PDF (fields editable, or flattened when flatten is true), read back to confirm each value, plus required fields still empty. Does not sign signature fields, does not change the user's original file, and does not fill XFA-only forms.

file.description: The fillable PDF form to fill, e.g. w9-like.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

flatten.description: true: make the filled values part of the page so they are no longer editable. Default false (fields stay editable).

values.description: The values to put in the form, e.g. [{"field":"full_name","value":"Jane Doe"},{"field":"agree","value":true}].

field.description: Field name as list_form_fields shows it, e.g. full_name or topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_01[0].

value.description: Text for a text field (e.g. Jane Doe), true/false for a checkbox, one option for a radio group or dropdown (e.g. Evening), or a list of options for a multi-select list box (e.g. ["Kitchen","Garden"]). An empty string clears the field.

name: fill_pdf_form
title: Fill a PDF form
